title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR EDGE-BASED MULTI-MODAL GEOTECHNICAL HAZARD PREDICTION USING DISTRIBUTED SENSOR FUSION AND PREDICTIVE INFERENCE
source: FORM 02_Integrated Edge Based System and Method for Proactive Geotechnical Hazard Analyzation and Alerting.docx
textFixes: Claim 6: removed stray leading 'T' before 'The system (100)'

paragraphs: An integrated edge-based geotechnical hazard analyzation and alerting system (100) for proactive prediction of geotechnical hazards, the system (100) comprising:

a sensor layer (101) comprising a plurality of distributed sensor nodes (101a, 101b), each sensor node comprising one or more heterogeneous sensing elements configured to continuously acquire geotechnical and environmental sensing information representative of conditions of a monitored geological formation;

a communication layer (102) communicatively coupled with the sensor layer (101) and configured to receive sensing information from the plurality of distributed sensor nodes (101a, 101b) and transmit aggregated sensing information to an edge computing layer (103);

an edge computing layer (103) communicatively coupled with the communication layer (102), the edge computing layer (103) comprising: a data preprocessing node (103a) configured to preprocess, synchronize, normalize, filter, and extract feature information from the aggregated sensing information; a predictive inference engine (103b) configured to execute one or more predictive inference models using the preprocessed sensing information to identify precursor patterns associated with impending geotechnical hazards; a risk assessment node (103c) configured to generate continuously updated hazard risk scores representative of a probability and severity of occurrence of one or more geotechnical hazards; and an alert generation node (103d) configured to generate one or more early warning alerts based upon the generated hazard risk scores; a data storage layer (104) communicatively coupled with the edge computing layer (103) and configured to selectively store processed sensing information, hazard assessment information, historical monitoring information, predictive model information, and alert information; and an application layer (105) communicatively coupled with the edge computing layer (103) and the data storage layer (104), the application layer (105) being configured to present monitoring information to one or more users and receive operational configuration commands,
wherein,
the edge computing layer (103) performs predictive hazard assessment locally using the pre-processed sensing information to reduce dependence upon continuous cloud communication;
the edge computing layer (103) locally buffers processed sensing information during interruption of communication connectivity while continuing hazard prediction;
the processed sensing information is selectively synchronized with the data storage layer (104) upon restoration of communication connectivity; and
configuration commands generated by the application layer (105) are communicated to the edge computing layer (103) to dynamically modify one or more monitoring parameters during system operation.

paragraphs: A method (200) for proactive geotechnical hazard analyzation and alerting, the method comprising:
acquiring heterogeneous sensing information from a plurality of distributed sensor nodes;
communicating the acquired sensing information to an edge computing layer;
pre-processing, synchronizing, filtering, and extracting feature information from the sensing information;
fusing heterogeneous sensing information;
executing one or more predictive inference models to identify precursor patterns associated with impending geotechnical hazards;
generating continuously updated hazard risk scores;
classifying the hazard risk scores into one or more hazard levels;
generating one or more early warning alerts based upon the classified hazard levels;
locally buffering processed sensing information during interruption of communication connectivity;
selectively synchronizing the buffered sensing information with a data storage layer after restoration of communication connectivity; and
presenting hazard assessment information through an application layer,

wherein predictive hazard assessment is continuously performed locally at the edge computing layer such that geotechnical monitoring and hazard prediction continue substantially uninterrupted under network-constrained communication conditions.
claims.text: A method (200) for proactive geotechnical hazard analyzation and alerting, the method comprising: acquiring heterogeneous sensing information from a plurality of distributed sensor nodes; communicating the acquired sensing information to an edge computing layer; pre-processing, synchronizing, filtering, and extracting feature information from the sensing information; fusing heterogeneous sensing information; executing one or more predictive inference models to identify precursor patterns associated with impending geotechnical hazards; generating continuously updated hazard risk scores; classifying the hazard risk scores into one or more hazard levels; generating one or more early warning alerts based upon the classified hazard levels; locally buffering processed sensing information during interruption of communication connectivity; selectively synchronizing the buffered sensing information with a data storage layer after restoration of communication connectivity; and presenting hazard assessment information through an application layer, wherein predictive hazard assessment is continuously performed locally at the edge computing layer such that geotechnical monitoring and hazard prediction continue substantially uninterrupted under network-constrained communication conditions.
